jobDescription:

Spec, IT Infrastructure Support deploys and supports the systems and technologies required by corporate, manufacturing, and distribution center users in a global enterprise environment. In addition to supporting all the technological needs of Polaris employees, Spec, IT Infrastructure Support, may also assist in providing local hands-on support for corporate tier 3 IS teams. ESSENTIAL DUTIES &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Assess and prioritize daily work based on outstanding Worldwide Service Desk issues. Ticket and time tracking using our ITSM solution, Service Now. Support of devices such as laptops, desktops, handheld barcode scanners, custom workstations, label printers, and other proprietary technology. Support for Windows based operating systems and Microsoft Office applications as well as other out of the box and developed software packages. Administration of Active Directory and O365 for all user and end-user system objects Provide local hands-on and remote support for corporate tier 3 IS teams including problem reporting and resolution for distribution centers, corporate offices, and manufacturing facilities. Maintain ongoing computer refresh and setups. Create documentation, standard work, and knowledge base articles. Act as a local resource for Worldwide Service Desk projects Manage IT Vendors and OEM contacts for procurement and operational requirements. Assist in IT Budgeting exercise. Perform with a continuous improvement mentality and provide metrics to show the realization. SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES REQUIRED: Advanced knowledge of modern computer hardware wired and wireless networking, handheld barcode scanners, IP phones, printers, and peripheral computer equipment required. Advanced knowledge of Windows 10, Windows 11, and Mac OS required. Experience configuring and maintaining laptops and desktops in an enterprise environment required. Experience with O365, specifically Outlook, Word, Excel, and Power Point Experience with Antivirus tools and Remote tools. Demonstrated experience in many areas of infrastructure like application or software deployments, Troubleshooting application issues. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and/or collaboratively with remote peers. Ability to deal collaboratively, diplomatically, and successfully with customers, co-workers and other professional colleagues, managers, and staff. Ability to work effectively in a team environment, as well as work independently with limited supervision. Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with the IT organization, management, and End users. 2-year technical degree or equivalent experience required 3-5 years’ experience working in an enterprise helpdesk setting required. jobDescription:

JOB SUMMARY: Actively maintain global emissions, vehicle systems and other product certifications for off-road vehicles as assigned. Implement new regulations and industry standards. Potential to provide local product compliance team leadership at the Bangalore Technology Center as needed to support growth. ESSENTIAL DUTIES &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Obtain and maintain global regulatory certifications of Polaris off-road vehicles as assigned. Implement regulatory requirements for new products and international markets. Ensure vehicle compliance with CPSC, US EPA, CARB, Environment Canada, European Commission, and other global regulatory agencies. Participate in periodic compliance status and continuous improvement meetings with the vehicle development and product compliance teams. Escalate product compliance issues to compliance department manager. Plan and coordinate with engineering, product management, and manufacturing to incorporate regulatory requirements in product specifications and validation plans. Provide input to Polaris industry association technical committee representatives as requested and stay informed of new requirements in assigned countries. Conduct and support product development process (PDP), part release system (PRS), and Bill of Material (BOM) compliance reviews and prepare required deliverables. Maintain and support development of automated compliance systems at Polaris. Support tracking of pre-certification units and emission-related defects. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES REQUIRED:

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

M.S. or B.S. degree in Engineering or technical field with a minimum of 7 years of motorized vehicle product compliance experience. Ability to communicate effectively with global partners. Vehicle systems and off-road vehicle / watercraft knowledge.

title: Technical Lead (IVI Middleware)
jobDescription:
At Polaris Inc., we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. JOB SUMMARY: Polaris, a global powersports leader, is looking for an experienced senior software engineer to join the embedded middleware team working with our In-vehicle displays and gauges. (IVI) This is an exciting position on a team building world-class connected rider solutions. As a senior technical contributor on the team, you will have the ability and empowerment to make changes and move quickly. The ideal candidate is effective in an Agile development environment, pushing solid software engineering practices and system maturity. Interest in powersports is a plus, as there are many opportunities to ride! ESSENTIAL DUTIES &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Collect and analyze systems and customer requirements. Provide high level estimate and task breakdown. Design and develop software according to the requirements. Perform design review, code review, and software implementations. This position requires writing C++ code. Flexible enough to work on multiple products being produced for a fast-changing market. Have a customer-focused mindset for delivering product centered to great customer experience. Analyze system performance for bottlenecks. Take a leadership role in the ongoing improvement efforts and retrospectives. Lead the team and be a positive influencer for high team morale and engagement. Other duties and responsibilities as needed. SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE: B Tech/ B.E in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, EE or related or MS in a related field. 12+ years of progressive C++ development experience and depth with templates, patterns, C++17 5+ years software development for IVI hardware and middleware projects. 5+ years software development for Automotive Bluetooth middleware projects. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable using desktop Linux and open-source tools for day-to-day development. Ability to quickly learn and apply new skills with minimal supervision. Familiarity with Agile software development methodology in Automotive. Experience implementing Linux applications and daemons within embedded systems. Experience with Blue Z, o Fono, OBEX, Pulse Audio and/or related open-source audio and media. Strong knowledge and experience with Bluetooth (Classic and LE) and audio/DSP technologies.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with unit testing and robot framework. Tier-1 or Tier-2 working experience for automotive industry. Experience with Android Auto, Apple Car Play or other projection technologies. Experience with using Android OS for automotive industry. Strong knowledge of CAN, Navigation, Apple Car Play, Sirius XM, and other IVI features. Strong knowledge of Linux kernel development. Good presentation and communication skills with ability to develop and present to high level executive, deep-dive technical presentation. Able to guide the team technically.
